description: This PHP file defines the class 'ResourceIdentifier' which implements interfaces related to JSON API resource identification within the SuiteCRM project. It manages resource 'type' and 'id' attributes, supports cloning with modifications, and serializes its state to a JSON API format.

classes.name: ResourceIdentifier
classes.description: Represents a JSON API resource identifier with 'type' and 'id' fields, supporting cloning with modifications, metadata, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Returns a clone of the object with a specified ID.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Returns a clone of the object with a specified type.

methods.name: withMeta
methods.description: Sets metadata for the resource identifier.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Assigns a logger instance for the object.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Serializes the resource identifier to a JSON API formatted array.
